question: The royal candidates seem to be getting along well now, but after the tense atmosphere at the royal castle, why do they all seem so friendly now? It seemed to me like Anastasia especially was very hard on Emilia.
answer: I think it’s not that unusual to treat people differently when you have something to gain from dealing with them. Of course, aside from Priscilla being rough on everyone, and Anastasia being rough on Emilia, the candidates weren’t getting along that badly to begin with.
